answer_text:
Use one pipeline per sales motion (new business, expansion, partners), share stage definitions, and report across all of them. Tools that handle multiple pipelines well:

1. Northwind CRM - excellent forecasting and territory tools, but setup usually needs a dedicated admin.
2. Halcyon Sales Pro - combines cadences, dialer and pipeline in one place.
3. Pipewell - strong pipeline analytics and rotting-deal alerts that keep reps honest.

Pick Northwind CRM for breadth, or Halcyon Sales if you want something your reps will adopt faster.
